plans.note: No standalone limitation-of-liability heading is supplied, but the outline skips sections 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 and 13+, so a cap/disclaimer clause is likely in an unlisted section; check sec-12 (indemnity) and sec-8 for embedded liability language and confirm any cap is mutual with carve-outs for IP, confidentiality and willful misconduct.
Sec-12 (INDEMNITY) is the operative clause; verify TrueLink indemnifies us for third-party IP infringement and its own misconduct, and that any Client-side indemnity in sec-12 or sec-8 stays narrow.

Presence check: Client covenants (sec-8) and the licence grant (sec-2) are the usual homes for restraints on our business; nothing in the supplied headings signals a non-compete, so likely absent pending review of unlisted sections.

Hosting/licence deals often place exclusivity in the licence grant (sec-2) or Client covenants (sec-8); scan for sole-source or 'exclusive provider of Hosting Services' language, including in compensation (sec-5).
Direction check on pricing: sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is the only supplied pricing section; no MFN wording is indicated, but confirm no most-favoured-terms obligation running against us.
Presence check: a non-solicit, if any, would sit with Client covenants (sec-8) or alongside confidentiality (sec-10); none flagged in the supplied outline.

No term/termination heading was supplied, yet the numbering gaps (sec-3, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13+) make a termination section very likely; request those sections before concluding, then confirm we may terminate on notice without penalty and TrueLink cannot exit mid-term.
Auto-renewal terms would live in the unsupplied term/termination section; also check sec-5 for renewal-period price escalators once the full text is available.
Governing law/venue is a miscellaneous provision that falls in the unlisted trailing sections; confirm New York, Delaware, California or England and Wales with courts rather than arbitration.

Assignment/change-of-control is likewise a boilerplate clause in the unsupplied sections; ensure we may assign to affiliates and successors and that TrueLink has no termination right on our change of control.

Direction check: sec-2 (LICENSE) and the definitions in sec-1 (Client, Hosting Services) drive ownership; confirm no assignment of our marks, content or customer data to TrueLink, and that sec-10 treats our data as our confidential property.
Sec-2 is the grant clause; test scope for affiliate and contractor use and delete any right to revoke or suspend the licence at will, reading with the sec-1 definitions.
Presence/parametric check: audit or inspection rights over our usage would appear in Client covenants (sec-8) or with fee reporting in sec-5; none evident in the supplied headings.

Direction check: look for penalties or per-incident charges payable by us in sec-5 and any spam-related penalty in sec-7 (UNSOLICITED COMMERCIAL E-MAIL); nothing else in the outline suggests liquidated damages.

Sec-8 covers only Client's covenants and warranties; a matching TrueLink warranty is likely in an unlisted section (e.g. sec-9) — request it and confirm a meaningful duration and remedy for the Hosting Services.
No insurance heading appears; since TrueLink hosts our site and data, propose adding standard commercial, cyber/E&O and workers' compensation coverage with certificates.
Sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is where minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay tiers would sit; if present, pair with a termination-for-convenience exit.

No transition or data-return clause is visible; sec-10 may address return/destruction of confidential information — check it and the unsupplied termination section, then add migration assistance and return of our data in a usable format.
